question: Can the exact 435-run future snapshot receive a machine-verifiable provisional split-integrity certificate under one fixed identifier/literal-erased syntactic representation?

ordered_classification.condition: both independent postflights pass; both primary coverage and integrity gates pass; within-future primary cross-run links equal zero; historical-to-future primary links equal zero
ordered_classification.allowed_claim: under the fixed representation and threshold, no high-similarity link was found across future physical runs or from the fixed historical critic-train population into the future snapshot

ordered_classification.condition: both independent postflights and all integrity gates pass, but one or both zero-link conditions are false
ordered_classification.allowed_claim: overlap remains within the pre-registered integrity gates, with every nonzero exception count reported

ordered_classification.condition: either postflight or any integrity gate fails
ordered_classification.allowed_claim: the provisional split-integrity certificate is withheld

must_report: fingerprinted and total future endpoints plus coverage
within-future primary and strict link counts
within-future primary cross-run and cross-task link counts
historical-to-future primary and strict link counts
historical-to-future same-task and cross-task link counts
all gate booleans, A/B receipts, independent postflight receipts, and manifest hashes
the known 404-run prior result and the provisional closure=false status
forbidden_inputs: prospective label, grade, outcome, winner orientation, prediction, accuracy, effect, or utility
task, run, card, code, or edge identities from either formal result
failure_rule: No threshold, representation, population, input result, task, run, subset, or classification rescue after either input result is read.
